results.name: autoUpgradeProfile
results.reason: Learn version selector identifies 2026-06-01 as latest stable GA; exact REST AutoUpgradeProfileProperties requires channel and the nested nodeImageSelection type. Bicep supplies both, with allowed channel values, a valid updateStrategy resource ID, boolean disabled, and an allowed Consistent enum.
results.migration: Current 2026-06-01 is latest GA; no GA migration needed.

current.analysis: Learn selector and pinned stable fleets.json identify 2026-06-01 as current. Schemas helper resolved AutoUpgradeProfile and AutoUpgradeProfileProperties; channel is required, nodeImageSelection.type is required, updateStrategyId is an arm-id restricted to fleets/updateStrategies, disabled is boolean, and the supplied literals match exact enums.

ga.analysis: Learn lists 2026-06-01 as the latest stable GA and 2026-06-02-preview as a newer preview. Exact candidate schema is the same pinned stable file; no preview was treated as GA.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log: 2026-06-01 adds AutoUpgradeProfileStatus.lastTriggerMessage; the current declaration does not use this response/status field. The required channel and node image selection constraints are unchanged.
